name: Talkiatry
one_liner: ✓ Clinician co-founded telepsychiatry with 800+ W2 psychiatrists, 90%+ retention. ~47-50% effective split (vs 62% at contractor platforms), but W2 benefits add significant value.
short_description: Nation's largest full-stack telepsychiatry provider with 800+ employed psychiatrists as W2 employees, proprietary AI-powered platform, and measurement-based care.
long_description: Talkiatry is the nation's largest full-stack telepsychiatry provider, directly employing over 800 board-certified psychiatrists as W-2 employees. Founded in 2019, the company operates on a proprietary AI-powered technology platform that includes a bespoke psychiatry EHR, intelligent patient-provider matching, and automated operational workflows. Talkiatry practices measurement-based care using standardized assessments including PHQ-9 and GAD-7, reporting strong clinical outcomes: 87% of anxiety patients and 86% of depression patients report symptom improvement after just two visits, with 67% and 62% respectively reporting no longer having clinically significant symptoms. The company is in-network with over 100 insurers covering 170+ million lives and has partnered with more than one-third of the nation's top 20 health systems through its Mindshare Partner Program. In February 2026, Talkiatry raised $210M in Series D funding to continue expansion.

seo.title: Talkiatry for Psychiatrists: Employment Review & Compensation | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Talkiatry employs 800+ psychiatrists as W2 with 90% retention. Clinician co-founded. $324k average comp (3.7/5 rating). Honest review for psychiatrists considering Talkiatry.

faqs.q: How much do Talkiatry psychiatrists make?
faqs.a: Talkiatry advertises $325,000-$375,000+ OTE (on-target earnings). A psychiatrist reported $324k total at 90% utilization of 37.5 patient-facing hours/week in January 2025, with $150k base. Our analysis suggests this works out to approximately 47-50% of generated professional revenue going to the psychiatrist (vs. ~62% at private practice contractor platforms). However, W2 benefits (health insurance, malpractice, 401k match, PTO, licensing) add significant value compared to 1099 arrangements.

Yes, Talkiatry was co-founded by Dr. Georgia Gaveras (board-certified psychiatrist) and Robert Krayn (tech/business). As Dr. Gaveras says, 'He's the money, I'm the medicine.' She was named to Modern Healthcare's 50 Most Influential Clinical Executives 2025.

Talkiatry uses base salary (~$150k) plus productivity-based incentives. The expected workload is 37.5 patient-facing hours/week at 90% utilization—roughly 6+ new patients daily plus follow-ups. Billing uses 99214/99204 + 90833 (E/M plus psychotherapy add-on). Our analysis of publicly available data suggests the effective split is approximately 47-50% to the psychiatrist, 50-53% to Talkiatry. Taking time off reduces incentive pay.

faqs.q: What is Talkiatry's effective compensation split?
faqs.a: Talkiatry doesn't disclose a fixed collections split like contractor platforms. Based on reported productivity expectations ($324k at 90% of 37.5 hours), visit structure (60-min intakes, 30-min follow-ups), and current reimbursement benchmarks, psychiatrist cash compensation appears to work out to roughly 47-50% of generated professional revenue. The uncertainty range is approximately 40-55% depending on Talkiatry's actual negotiated rates with payers. Evidence suggests Talkiatry may get above-market reimbursement due to scale.

faqs.q: What is Talkiatry's psychiatrist retention rate?
faqs.a: Talkiatry reports 90%+ provider retention rate, compared to 30-40% industry average. This suggests above-average clinician satisfaction despite compensation concerns in some reviews.
